data: First 8 FLEURS ar_eg test clips: first 4 development validation, next 4 held-out test. Read Arabic speech, NOT validated conversational Egyptian dialect.
normalization: Lowercase, Arabic diacritics removed, alef/ya normalization, punctuation removed, spaces collapsed.
limitations: Very small convenience pilot. This cannot establish merchant speech accuracy, dialect robustness or noise robustness. No fine-tuning.
